Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme’s evaluation goals and the integration constraints. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for internal search and chat by 30% while keeping cost per 1000 queries under $X.
- Evaluation scope: search, chat, and embeddings for two product teams (Search & Assist).
- Success criteria: <10% performance regression vs current model on our eval set; integration within 4–6 weeks.
- Risks: data residency for EU customers (flagged for later), some heavy long-context use cases.

I attached a first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an evaluation checklist. The MAP proposes owners and milestone dates so we can keep timelines transparent between teams. Can you confirm: 1) who on your side will own the integration (tech lead / PM), and 2) whether the proposed dates look realistic?

Attachments: Acme - Redwood Mutual Action Plan v1.0.pdf, RI-Eval-Checklist.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm owners/dates (this thread)
- We schedule a 30-min kickoff with engineering (I’ll include an SE)
- We provision a short proof-of-concept environment and share an eval prompt set

I’ve CC’d Marissa (sales lead) and Aditya (solutions engineer) so they’re looped in for the timeline and technical kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners and dates.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
